**evaluation** — THE BENCH OVER THE ONE-CLICK CANDIDATES.
- entry_condition: G-JOURNEY-RESEARCH is green — the journey ground pinned whole, the candidates mapped.
- purpose: FOUR parallel ungated packets, every seat pricing the candidates against its own discipline — hyoka's adversarial attack (the misclick class, the accessibility, the no-undo risk); moho's blind walks (the candidate forms walked as the human: the click, the operator's read, the vote's landing); keisan's pricing (every candidate against the constraints: the free-tier spirit, the llm-class, the stamps unchanged, the landed surfaces); shindan's residual diagnosis (every candidate's residual: what remains two-step, what the simplification cannot reach) — the divergences reconciled at togo's design synthesis, never averaged away; the stage carries no gate of its own — its weight rides the design gate.

**recommendation** — THE DESIGN RULED AT THE GATE.
- entry_condition: the evaluation's packets landed whole — every candidate attacked, walked, priced, diagnosed; the divergences carried whole.
- purpose: suisen's full-depth whole (the one-click form designed whole — the option itself the choice, the comparison operator between the two options, the two-step radio-plus-submit retired; the operator's form; the entire system's simplification map — every surface of the human's path measured against the primary purpose, the divergences resolved, the honest residuals named) + togo's gated synthesis integrating the whole bench's findings — closing G-JOURNEY-DESIGN at the collaborator's ruling on the full record: the design judged publicly right, the build set earned by the cycle's outcome (the one-click card the likely first unit; the journey findings' cures; the ack/done/result surfaces per the design's map; the README's story).

- entry_condition: G-JOURNEY-DESIGN is green — the design's map rules the unit set; each unit's own brief gate green before its dispatch (the precedence law); the build-add auto-stamp the pair's sole creator (FR-MEM-0034's law).

**close** — THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the standing form).
- entry_condition: the route's build gates closed green and the collaborator has called the close.

## 3. THE ECOSYSTEM'S ONE-COMPARISON PATTERNS (each: the mechanism + the accessibility truth)
- PATTERN 1 — THE BUTTON-AS-CHOICE (the tree's own pattern): the choice a named submit button; one click casts; the submitter's pair rides the POST. TRUTH: the native <button> is focusable, keyboard-activatable (Enter/Space), announced with role + accessible name — zero ARIA needed (the native-semantics principle, WCAG 4.1.2's preference for native); the structural trait: the button row sits APART from the options — the mapping textual (the marker names), the targets button-sized (never option-sized).
- PATTERN 2 — THE CARD/TILE-CLICK (the one-click target's class; the survey platforms' single-question-per-screen + big-tile surfaces — the 2AFC preference tests' shape, the psychophysics heritage). THE THREE MECHANISM FORMS: (a) THE RADIO-CARD — a real radio input wrapped by the card-as-label: the click anywhere on the card checks the radio (the label's native behavior — the largest target carrying the radio's native semantics); the cast then rides EITHER the submit (the two-step) OR a change-listener (the JS one-click); (b) THE CARD-AS-BUTTON — the whole card a <button>: one click, native submit, no JS; the button's content model is phrasing content (MDN <button>), so the card's block structure restructures; (c) THE DIV-WITH-ONCLICK — the common broken form: no keyboard, no focus, no role — WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) + 4.1.2 (Name/Role/Value) both fail until rebuilt as the ARIA-button pattern (APG: role="button" + tabindex="0" + Enter/Space keydown — a re-implementation of the button with more bytes and less nativeness).
- PATTERN 3 — THE RADIO-GROUP (the classic "choose one of N"): native semantics — the group announced as a group (fieldset/legend or aria-labelledby), the arrow keys ROVE AND CHECK within the group (native radio behavior), the checked state announced. TRUTH: the radio group is the semantically HONEST "choose A or B" (the question bound to the group at the announcement — the reader hears the group's name + "1 of 3"); BUT the radio's ONE-CLICK form is the cast-on-change, and THE ARROW KEYS THEMSELVES WOULD CAST — the keyboard user's browsing becomes the ballot (the misclick's keyboard cousin, a structural hazard the APG's radio pattern exists to manage); the radio+submit form (the convening's described shape) is the no-JS-safe form at two clicks.
- PATTERN 4 — THE DRAG-TO-PREFER (the card-sort/kanban class): pointer-only by construction; the APG's guidance: drag operations need a non-pointer alternative — the alternative IS a click/select form (the very two-step being retired, or a click form). The pattern's one-gesture form is the set's LEAST accessible: the gesture itself the barrier.
- PATTERN 5 — THE HOTKEY (the rapid-annotation class: the 1/2/3 keys of the crowdsourcing/annotation platforms; the terminal's A/B): the keyboard the pattern's NATIVE lane (a motor-access benefit). TRUTHS: the keys must be SHOWN on the targets (the kbd hint) or undiscoverable; single-char shortcuts meet WCAG 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts (remappable/deactivatable or active only on focus); the form is additive-only in the accessible composition (the click stays primary — the switch user's path never removed).
- PATTERN 6 — THE SWIPE (the dating-app class; the touch-first A/B): a gesture language (left/right = A/B). TRUTHS: gesture-only fails 2.1.1 (a keyboard equivalent must exist); the swipe's meaning is learned, never read (undiscoverable cold); the form is app-bound (not the HTML/fragment class).
- THE PATTERN SPACE'S OWN ORDERS (the axes' structures — the map, never a recommendation): ONE-GESTURE: card-click = swipe = drag > button > radio+submit. NATIVE SEMANTICS: button = radio-card > radio > ARIA-button > drag > swipe. TARGET SIZE: card/tile > swipe-track > button > radio-dot (the label cures the dot). READER HONESTY: the radio group's announcement > ungrouped buttons (the group semantics bind the question). KEYBOARD SAFETY AT ONE-CLICK: button/tile > the cast-on-change radio (the arrow-cast hazard). UNDO: orthogonal to the choice pattern (the ack's correction affordance — the verb exists at the wire, uncarried at the browser lane, section 2).

HYOKA'S ADVERSARIAL ATTACK — the journey candidates (packet evaluation/adversarial, route prioritree-journey, 2026-11-27)

The bench's recommendations attacked against the tree's own bytes — every claim below read at my own eyes this pass (pair.html, sitting.html, vote-ack.html, landing.html, picker.html, base.html, app.css, app.js whole; web.py's guard :276-291, vote POST :1127-1224, judge :807-890, done :726-763, fragment done edge :1103-1104; votes.py's cast chain :480-541; the record's own run files). The standard: the convening's four clauses + the standing constraints (the landed surfaces ridden never rewritten; the stamps unchanged; the llm-class at its own weight; the no-anchoring law; the zero-ignore law) + WCAG 2.2 AA at the card unit. Every finding carries its severity and the forced answer the design synthesis must carry.

FINDING 1 — THE NO-FORM CARD PAIR VIOLATES THE LANDED-SURFACES CONSTRAINT [BLOCKING, severity HIGH]
The recommendation (a) as stated — "two buttons styled as the cards, hx-post on each" — is a NO-FORM pattern. At the bytes it pays four composition costs the form-wrapped card pair pays zero of:
(1) THE CSRF REWRITE: the guard reads the form field ALONE (web.py:276-277, form.get(_CSRF_FIELD)); a no-form hx-post carries no form field — the token must ride hx-headers or the meta+configRequest recipe, BOTH demanding the guard's SECOND READ LANE — a rewrite of the landed CSRF surface (the standing constraint: ridden, never rewritten). The carriers priced: hx-headers leaves the token in the DOM (the SAME exposure class as today's hidden field — also DOM-resident; the exposure honest, no worse — the cost is the read-lane rewrite, not the exposure); the meta+configRequest recipe mints per PAGE against the fragment chain's FRESH-TOKEN LAW (the fragment's mint at web.py:1115 per fetch — a page-carried meta goes stale at the second judgment; the recipe needs a per-fragment body carrier re-read by the listener: more machinery, not less).
(2) THE ASK'S REWRITE: the identify-once conditional ask rides the form today (pair.html:4-7); a no-form card must hx-include the ask — the tree's own retired pattern's return, a rewrite of the landed session surface.
(3) THE STAMPS' RE-CARRIAGE: item_a/item_b/presentation_order/chain/deliberate ride the form's hidden fields (pair.html:8-13); a no-form card re-carries all five per click, on EACH card.
(4) THE SYNC GAP: hx-sync="this" (the htmx-native in-flight guard, absent today — rikai §5) drops a second request from the SAME element; the different-verdict double-click lands on the OTHER card — a different element. The no-form pair must invent a shared sync context (a named ancestor selector); the form-wrapped pair owns one natively (the form).
THE CURE (the forced answer): THE FORM-WRAPPED CARD PAIR — the two cards BECOME type="submit" buttons inside the STANDING form (name="winner" value="prefer-a/prefer-b"; the badge + label as the button's phrasing content — sl-badge and span are phrasing content, the content model legal), the operator rendered between them as a display element (never focusable, never a target), the tie a third control in the same form. The wire byte-identical (the submitter's name/value rides the POST — pair.html:20's own standing mechanism); the CSRF field, the ask, the stamps, the ack target, the guard, the refusal's same-pair-retryable separation — ALL UNTOUCHED. The recommendation's MEANING survives (the card IS the choice, the marker translation dead); its MECHANISM ("hx-post on each") is REFUSED — the form wrapper keeps it. The in-flight race then carries its cure: the shared sync context (hx-sync at the form, the drop strategy) + the idempotent ack for the same-verdict double-click (votes.py:509-514, verified) + the undo as the different-verdict backstop (finding 2).

FINDING 2 — THE UNDO'S RE-CLICK LANDS AT THE WRONG LANE [BLOCKING at the package level, severity HIGH]
The recommendation (c): "the stay-put card carrying the last vote's id; a different-verdict re-click riding supersedes." THE ATTACK AT THE BYTES: the STAY-PUT CARD exists at the DELIBERATE lane alone (web.py:1206-1209's stay-put arm — the card untouched below the ack); at the CHAIN lane — where the misclick class lives at the priced 0.78/sitting — the ack's fetch div REPLACES #pair-region at the ack's load (vote-ack.html:5's else arm, hx-swap="outerHTML"): the just-voted card is DESTROYED in the sub-second round-trip, long before the human's realization latency (the "wait, no" moment lives at the seconds scale against the measured 1.597 s rhythm). The re-click-at-the-card cures the deliberate lane (3 clicks/judgment, the completion-card user — the lane that needs the undo LEAST) and meets a CLOSED WINDOW at the chain lane (the lane that needs it MOST).
THE STALE-ID CLASS refuted at the wire: a re-click carrying a stale id (the ack's id at a swapped or different card) is REFUSED by the supersede ground truth — the target must be a live handle in the same run ON THE SAME PAIR (votes.py:507-509, :522-525, SupersedeRefusedError before any byte lands); the DOM's age buys nothing dishonest. The author check holds the malicious-correction class too (finding 8).
THE CURE (the forced answer): THE UNDO RIDES THE ACK at the chain lane — the correction affordance at the ack line, where it SURVIVES the fetch (the ack region is the swap's TARGET, never its victim — the same separation the refusal law already rides, web.py:1152-1155). The honest form at the wire's own law: the ack's "undo this judgment" re-serves the just-judged pair WITH the supersede carry (the hidden supersedes=VOTE-{id}; the pair re-rendered at #pair-region), and the human's corrected click rides supersedes — 2 clicks when used, 0 when unused, the correction ONLY superseding (never an inverse-verdict fabrication: the wire has no delete verb; the supersede DEMANDS the human's new verdict — votes.py:534-535). The deliberate lane's re-click composes TOO (the card stays put there): both lanes one law — the different-verdict correction cites the last vote.
THE FORCED ANSWER: keisan's 3-file-unit window AMENDED in shape, not in weight — one supersedes key at the POST's payload (web.py:1177-1183 grows one field), the ack template grows the affordance + the deliberate re-click copy, the tests ride both; the tally's weighting walks the link (the wire's own law, $0 at the record/tools lanes which already own the verb).

FINDING 3 — THE RECORD MOVED UNDER THE BENCH: THE FIRST SUPERSEDE IS LIVE [severity MEDIUM — the evidence's own update]
Keisan's "zero supersedes in every run file — 0/319" was true at his pass. RUN-0009 (registered 2026-11-27T19:40:49Z, after this packet's dispatch — moho's concurrent evaluation/walks) carries THE FIRST SUPERSEDE IN THE RECORD: VOTE-0001 ("the eyes meant river, the click landed on meadow — the honest mistake lived") superseded 6.015 s later by VOTE-0002 ("the re-click: the meant card, the wrong first cited — the correction lived"), both at the tools lane, comparator_class "llm". THE MEANING: (i) the accidental-cast class is NO LONGER UNOBSERVED — the first honest instance at the bench's own record, corrected at the six-second latency; (ii) the correction's wire path PROVEN live (the supersede accepted, the author check passed); (iii) keisan's datum stands for the human-browser lane, now honestly supplemented. THE FORCED ANSWER: the design cites 0/319-at-the-browser-lane PLUS one observed misclick + one observed correction at the walk's tools lane — never the bare 0/319; the undo's build case STRENGTHENS (the class observed, the cure observed, both at the record).

FINDING 4 — THE FOCUS/ARIA-LIVE CURES ARE NOT OPTIONAL RIDES: THE CARD UNIT FAILS THE BAR WITHOUT THEM [severity HIGH — the package (d) binding confirmed]
Two truths verified at the bytes (rikai §4a/§4b, at my own eyes: sitting.html:17's plain div id="ack-region" — no role, no aria-live; pair.html:20's buttons carry no ids):
(a) THE FOCUS DESTRUCTION: the chain's swap destroys the focused cast control EVERY judgment; htmx's restoration keys on the id; absent the id, focus falls to body — the keyboard user re-enters the tab order at the section's top per judgment. At the card form the breach WIDENS (the cards become the tab order's primary members; the deliberate lane's re-click demands focus AT the card).
(b) THE SILENT SWAP: the ack's content is NOT announced (no aria-live at the ack region) — the reader never hears the confirmation, the undo affordance, or the refusal.
THE CURE (the forced answer, riding the card unit — never a separate unit): (i) STABLE IDS on the cast controls (id="cast-a"/"cast-b" + the tie — pair-stable, never pair-specific) so htmx's restoration carries the focus across the swap to the next pair's same-named control — zero JS; (ii) aria-live="polite" at the ack region (one attribute); (iii) THE GROUP SEMANTICS: the fieldset/legend wrapping the card pair + the tie inside the form, the legend binding the question — the reader hears the GROUP ("{question}, 3 items"), never three bare buttons; the accessible names carrying the option's label + marker (the recommendation's own naming demand CONFIRMED — "prefer river (A)", never "Prefer A" alone). THE PACKAGE'S BINDING: the card unit without these three is not the one-click target the convening ruled — it is a wider breach than today's (the bigger target, the same destruction, the same silence).

FINDING 5 — THE TIE'S SUBORDINATE CONTROL: THE 24PX BAR + THE TAB'S THIRD PLACE + THE DECLARED SET WHOLE [severity MEDIUM — recommendation (b) confirmed with its bounds]
The tie's rarity priced at the record: ZERO tie verdicts in EVERY run file (grep "winner": "tie" over .prioritree/runs — no match; the tie DECLARED in every manifest — the wire's structural necessity, votes.py:500-501 reads the run's own declared set — NEVER CAST at the whole record). The subordinate form's justification CONFIRMED: the rare verdict earns the small control, never an equal card. THE ATTACK'S BOUNDS: (i) the 24×24 CSS px minimum (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 AA) — "small" must not breach the bar; the control at the operator's row / the cards' base, the 12px gap (app.css:2) held from the cards; (ii) the tab order's third place: the DOM order = the visual order (the tie AFTER the two cards); (iii) THE DECLARED SET RENDERS WHOLE: the loop reads the run's OWN verdicts (pair.html:19-20) — the tie control must remain LOOP-DRIVEN (a run declaring two verdicts renders no tie control; the wire's declared set, never a hardcoded third button). THE FORCED ANSWER: the tie as the loop's third member, styled subordinate, named honestly ("Tie — both stand equal") — the structural necessity kept, the rarity priced in the styling.

FINDING 6 — THE MICRO-BRIDGE ATTACKED: THE :757 CURE SURVIVES WHOLE [severity LOW — verified, no residual]
(a) THE :757 302: the blast radius ZERO at the htmx lanes — :757's sole inbound lanes are the PLAIN anchors at vote-ack.html:5 (the deliberate + chain arms' done links); no htmx fetch ever targets the page route (the fragment's done edge is :1104, untouched by the cure; the unremember lane :1275, untouched); base.html carries no hx-boost and app.js intercepts only data-pt-path submits (app.js:17-24, verified) — the plain browser is the ONLY caller, and the 302/303 is its own verb. The cache class: 302/303 never cached by default (the non-permanent class — 301/308 would poison); the docstring's stated intent (:733-734) finally true at the bytes. ONE LINE, VERIFIED.
(b) THE RE-CAST COPY: one template conditional + one context flag; the copy names the reload law ALONE (never a queue consult — the queue-blind ruling held at :1206-1209); the token refresh REFUSED at its two-step-law brush (web.py:643-645) — priced, not recommended.
(c) THE CONFTEST'S F401: the zero-ignore law governs — the warm-up import fires F401 unless the bound name is REFERENCED (the honest zero-findings form: the name used at a fixture or a module-level reference); the NAMED per-file ruling the fallback (per-file-ignores naming conftest.py:F401 with the law in the comment), NEVER a global; the lazy restructure stays earned-later (FR-MEM-0045's own disposition).
(d) THE QUORUM LABEL: the 45-word label (landing.html:14, counted at my own eyes) shrinks to its ask; the corroboration teaching ALREADY LIVES at the acted-on surfaces (sitting.html:15's quorum>1 line + done.html:8) — the move loses nothing; the cure survives.

FINDING 7 — THE PICKER'S NEXT-UNJUDGED AFFORDANCE: THE LAWFUL SHAPE IS THE CHAIN LINK, NEVER A PICKER-SIDE CONSULT [severity MEDIUM — recommendation (f) narrowed]
The wall stands (156 links at the 13-item run — the honest completion-card form; the no-anchoring law held by construction, the counts unread at the controller). THE ATTACK on the next-unjudged affordance: a picker-side next consult reads coverage state at the picker's render — the deliberate lane's queue-blind ruling brushed (the vote's own :1206-1209 law) and the affordance's PRESENCE implies queue state (a soft anchoring surface). THE CURE: the affordance rides the SITTING page as a plain link to the CHAIN lane ("return to the sitting's flow — the next unjudged pair at one click per judgment" — the chain's own next consult, the one the sitting already owns); the picker untouched, the wall standing for its honest user, the casual scroller handed the chain's exit. THE FORCED ANSWER: the next-unjudged affordance = a link to the chain, never a picker-side consult. The register's id+label merge composes at the controller (the label defaulting to the id at the register's parse — the wire's manifest schema untouched; RUN-0008's 13/13 id==label the common case priced).

FINDING 8 — THE PACKAGE'S BINDING ATTACKED HARDEST: TRUE, AND TIGHTER THAN STATED [the verdict on the recommendations whole]
The package claim — "the card form only honest with the undo riding" — attacked: is the binding true? YES, and tighter than stated: (i) the card without the undo is DISHONEST at the misclick class (the accidental cast lands and counts [R9, votes.py:530-538]; the chain never re-serves the pair; the correction today the tools detour — and the class NOW OBSERVED at RUN-0009, finding 3); (ii) the card without the accessibility rides is ILLEGAL at the AA bar (finding 4); (iii) the card without the form wrapper is UNCOMPOSABLE with the landed surfaces (finding 1). THE BINDING'S TRUE SHAPE: ONE BUILD UNIT carrying (a) the form-wrapped card pair + the operator + the loop-driven tie; (b) the stable ids + the aria-live + the group semantics; (c) the supersedes field at the POST + the ack's undo affordance + the deliberate re-click — never the card landing alone, never the undo a separate dispatch that might not fire.
THE RESIDUALS PRICED HONESTLY AFTER THE PACKAGE: (i) the correction is same-pair, same-author, same-session — the window closes at the sitting's end (the cross-sitting correction stays the tools lanes' own; the compensating re-judgment at the deliberate lane remains legal); (ii) the malicious-correction class REFUTED as a new surface: the wire's author check (the target must be the caller's own vote on the same pair — votes.py:507-509) refuses the forged id; the id's forgeability buys nothing the web lane's standing name-claim class doesn't already own (the self-claimed comparator_id at the first vote is the lane's pre-existing trust, unchanged by the undo); (iii) the discoverability residual: the re-click's law must be NAMED at the ack's copy (the deliberate arm's ack teaches "click the other card to correct — the correction supersedes this judgment"), else the affordance is undiscoverable (the hotkey's kbd-hint law, rikai §3); (iv) the confirm dialog STAYS REFUTED at the verified 200:1 (my own trace: 78 ÷ 0.39 = 200; keisan's 100-400× at the range's edges; the flow's death at 78 dialogs/sitting).

THE SURVIVORS (each candidate's verdict, none unchanged):
- (a) THE CARD-AS-BUTTON: SURVIVES, AMENDED to the form-wrapped pair (finding 1) — the mechanism refused, the meaning kept.
- (b) THE TIE'S SUBORDINATE CONTROL: SURVIVES with its bounds (finding 5) — the 24px bar, the tab's third place, the declared set whole.
- (c) THE UNDO'S RE-CLICK: SURVIVES, AMENDED to the two-lane form (finding 2) — the ack's affordance at the chain lane, the re-click at the stay-put card; the record's first supersede live (finding 3).
- (d) THE ACCESSIBILITY RIDES: SURVIVES, BINDING at the card unit (finding 4) — the three cures named, never separate.
- (e) THE MICRO-BRIDGE: SURVIVES whole (finding 6) — the :757 one-line at zero blast radius; the copy bounded; the conftest at the zero-findings form; the quorum label's move loses nothing.
- (f) THE REGISTER/PICKER LEANS: the quorum copy and the id+label merge SURVIVE; the next-unjudged affordance NARROWED to the chain link (finding 7).

THE BOTTOM LINE: every candidate survives its attack with its cure carried — none survives unchanged. The two blocking amendments (findings 1 + 2) are the design synthesis's forced answers: the FORM WRAPPER keeps the landed surfaces ridden; the UNDO'S HONEST HOME IS THE ACK. The record's own first supersede (RUN-0009) closes the misclick class's "never observed" residual — the package's binding proven at the bench's own bytes. This report is the attack whole; the design gate rules on the walked, priced, attacked record.

SHINDAN'S RESIDUAL DIAGNOSIS — packet evaluation/residual-diagnosis (prioritree-journey, the evaluation stage's fourth ungated packet), 2026-11-27.

THE GROUND READ: togo's research brief (reports/synthesize/journey-research.md); my own findings diagnosis (reports/research/findings-diagnosis.md); the coordinator's recommendations whole (the card-as-button [two buttons styled as the cards, hx-post on each, the accessible names carrying the full labels, the operator between]; the tie's subordinate affordance [a small third control, never an equal card]; the undo's re-click-as-supersede [the stay-put card carrying the last vote's id; a different-verdict re-click riding supersedes; the confirm dialog refuted at 200:1]; the accessibility cures riding the card unit [the aria-live, the focus restoration]; the micro-bridge [the :757 302, the re-cast copy, the conftest, the quorum label]; the register/picker leans). THE BYTES RE-VERIFIED AT MY OWN EYES THIS PASS: pair.html whole (the display-only sl-cards :14-17 + the three id-less submit-type verdict buttons :18-21); sitting.html:16-17 (the shared pair.html include + the plain #ack-region div — no role, no aria-live); vote-ack.html's four arms (:5); pairs.html + picker.html (the deliberate lane's surfaces, the 156 links at 13 items); web.py:808-887 (the judge route renders sitting.html — the SAME shared pair fragment serves both lanes; the deliberate datum :836-840); votes.py:483-682 (the cast chain + the supersedes door :617-652 — the same run, the SAME PAIR, the author's own hand); tally.py:165-183 (the exclusion set E — the superseded never counted, never corroborating); session.py:104-120 (the counted per-class rollup); policy.py:69-89 (the corroboration predicate — >=1 human AND >=1 llm over one pair's per-class COUNTS); cli.py:62/:347 + mcp_server.py:185/:607 (the tools lanes' supersedes); landing.html:12-25 (the register's asks); RUN-0008.jsonl's manifest (13/13 id==label identical) + the record's grep census at my hand (ZERO "winner": "tie" and ZERO non-null supersedes in EVERY run file under .prioritree/runs — the tie's and the supersede's 0/319 both). READ-ONLY held — this report the packet's only write.

(1) THE CARD-AS-BUTTON'S RESIDUAL (what remains after the card unit lands):

- THE DELIBERATE LANE'S JUDGE PAGE — THE SAME CARD FORM, BY CONSTRUCTION: web.py:808-887's judge route renders sitting.html, which includes pair.html (:16) — ONE shared fragment serves both lanes.
